caption: The Shopify dialog Install app for Disputifier: Smart Chargebacks by Disputifier, with the access it asks for: View customer data (Sensitive data, device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner, blog contributors) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, orders, Shopify Payments, Online Store), and the buttons Cancel and Install. The store name at the bottom left of the admin menu is covered.

Step 1, Initial Set Up, of the welcome wizard of Disputifier: Recover Your Chargebacks, the question What's your email? (Please enter your personal work email, not your support email. This is for urgent communication so it needs to be an inbox that you monitor.) with an empty field at this moment, How did you hear about us? set to App store, and optional alternative contact info (WhatsApp or Telegram). The steps listed are Initial Set Up, Select Payment Processor, Add Chargeback Fighting and Select Business Model. No personal data is shown.

Step 2, Select Payment Processor: Set the payment processors you use for your business, a grid of logos (Shopify Payments selected, then Stripe, Klarna, Afterpay, Amazon Pay, PayPal, Braintree, Maverick, Netevia, SignaPay, Oceanpayment, GOAT Payments, Airwallex, Payments Hub and MerLink DRS). Nothing was connected. No personal data is shown.

Step 3, Add Chargeback Fighting: Respond to chargebacks automatically? with the card Fully Automated (MOST POPULAR, ticked: Fully automated chargeback responding, Guaranteed win rate increase, Only pay when we successfully win a chargeback, 20% of Chargeback Revenue Recovered) next to the card Don't Respond to Chargebacks (Not Recommended). The text above says the average Disputifier user wins over 58% of disputes, which is the vendor's own figure. No personal data is shown.
